_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Accident Incident Report
summary: The Accident Incident Report notifies the government of accidental, non-routine incidents involving personnel injury, property damage, security violations, or other significant incidents.
use_relationship:
The Accident Incident Report provides the government with notification of incidents that happen accidentally, are not in the usual course of operations, are not according to expectations, and are not routine. The report covers incidents resulting in any one or more of the following: personnel injury, property damage, security violation, or other significant incidents.
This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be presented in a format similar to that in Figure 1.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain all of the information in Part 1 through Part 4 of Figure 1.

children.title: The Report shall identify incidents resulting in any one or more of the following:
Personnel Injury
children.content: Any incident that involves injury that could result in loss of time from work and requires medical treatment beyond first aid.

children.title: All property damage or loss regardless of dollar value.
Any accident that involves vehicle damage or property damage caused by a vehicle.
Any incident involving protection of Tactical Training Range facilities, computer networks, or computer environments.
Any incident that involves the loss, compromise, or suspected compromise of classified or sensitive information.
Any incident that involves unauthorized changes to the Information Assurance posture of a computer network as defined in the respective SSAA will be considered a violation.
Any incident the submitter is unable to resolve under the three other categories.

Any incident that occurs on the range where the Contract Site Manager (CSM) or Range System Manager (RSM) determine that an Accident/Incident Report is warranted to preclude a similar occurrence on the Combined Tactical Training Ranges (CTTR).
A summary of what happened in the incident
children.content: A summary of what happened in the incident shall be included.

children.title: The events preceding the investigation
children.content: The events preceding the investigation shall be specified in reverse order of occurrence, starting with the event and moving backward in time. A reconstruction of the steps that led to the investigation shall also be included.

children.title: Causal factors of the chain of events leading to the accident or incident
children.content: Causal factors of the chain of events leading to the accident or incident shall be included.

children.title: Actions and corrective actions to prevent re-occurrence
children.content: The report shall include actions and corrective actions that have been or will be taken to prevent re-occurrence, the timeframe for performing all actions and corrective actions, as well as the associated work order that will be used to track cost.
